failure_modes.cause: Long coil length (24 m) of small ID tubing (0.75 mm) susceptible to bending radius violations during installation or thermal expansion/contraction cycles
failure_modes.mitigation: Use rigid support structures with defined minimum bend radii (e.g., 5x OD) and perform visual inspection under pressure before reaction start

failure_modes.mode: Incomplete quenching due to mixing limitations
failure_modes.cause: Enhanced laminar mixing regime (Re=16) may not achieve instantaneous homogeneity for rapid quench step, leading to post-reaction side products or hazardous intermediate accumulation
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement static mixer element immediately post-reactor coil and validate quench efficiency via inline UV-Vis or IR spectroscopy

failure_modes.mode: Pressure surge from BPR failure or blockage
failure_modes.cause: Back Pressure Regulator (BPR) blockage by precipitates or mechanical failure, causing pressure to exceed pump limit or tubing rating
failure_modes.mitigation: Install pressure relief valve set at 1.5x operating pressure and use inline filter before BPR to prevent particulate blockage

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
Single pump failure — no redundancy for continuous operation
validation_experiments: Perform pressure decay test on assembled 24 m coil at 1.5x operating pressure (0.435 bar) for 30 min to detect leaks or weak points
Run quench validation with model compound at Q=0.56 mL/min; analyze outlet stream for unquenched intermediate using HPLC to confirm mixing efficiency
Simulate BPR blockage by closing downstream valve; verify pressure relief valve activates at set point and system depressurizes safely
